title: Cross Site scripting/injection in ReferringUndefinedPagesPlugin in Apache JSPWIKI on all platforms allows specific…
description: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the ReferringUndefinedPagesPlugin of Apache JSPWIKI on all platforms. This flaw allows specific fields in the plugin to render unescaped content to the browser, potentially enabling script injection. The issue is addressed in version 3.0.1, which users are recommended to upgrade to.
